logline: A demoted Liverpool cop holding himself together with tape and therapy works night shifts in a city that reflects every crack in his fractured conscience.

bollymeter.basis: 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from 23 critics. Freeman's performance won him the International Emmy for Best Actor; critics called it a wholesale reinvention of British crime drama.

pull_quotes.text: Freeman brings a chilling intensity to Chris, whose coiled-up rage threatens to strangle the last bit of humanity lingering in his soul.
It kind of takes the normal police procedural and throws it on the floor and stamps on it.

seasons.review_body: Series 1 of The Responder landed in January 2022 to unanimous critical acclaim - 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from 23 reviewers and an 88 Metascore from 13 critics. Creator Tony Schumacher drew on his own experience as a Liverpool cop to write a portrait of policing at the margins: night shifts, street-level drug dealing, the bureaucratic contempt of management. Critics clustered on two things - the way the show dismantled procedural conventions entirely, and Martin Freeman's career-defining performance as PC Chris Carson, a man so saturated in trauma and guilt that his anger management sessions feel like pressure valves on a boiler about to burst. Entertainment Weekly noted his "chilling intensity." The Times called it a return with "as much swagger" as its debut. Adelayo Adedayo as his rookie partner Rachel drew strong notices as the show's moral compass. Season 1 won Best Drama at the 2022 Edinburgh TV Awards.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The opening hour drops PC Chris Carson into a Liverpool night shift and refuses to explain him slowly. His terror, shame, and occasional vicious competence arrive simultaneously. Critics found it disorienting in the best possible way - a cop show that treats its protagonist as the emergency.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Chris's first confrontation on the streets establishes immediately that his methods and his psychology are inseparable - and both are damaged.

critic_note.text: The Responder feels like a massive breath of fresh air among crime dramas.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 5
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The series finale compresses every thread - Carl Sweeney's criminal debts, Rachel's crisis of conscience, Kate's ultimatum - into a single night that is almost unbearably tense. The show refuses a comfortable resolution.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final scene reframes what the whole series has been about - not policing, but a man trying to survive his own history.

bollymeter.basis: 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from 15 critics. The consensus called it 'as battered, bruised, and resilient as its compelling antihero' - critics found it tighter and more devastating than the first.

pull_quotes.text: Putting Martin Freeman's character through the absolute ringer, this second season proves as battered, bruised, and resilient as its compelling antihero.

seasons.review_body: Series 2 arrived in May 2024 to the same near-perfect critical reception as the first - 100% from 15 reviewers, with the consensus praising a season even more emotionally unsparing than its predecessor. Schumacher tightens the vice on Chris Carson: the therapy sessions grow more pointed, the criminal entanglements closer to home, the marriage under greater strain. Critics noted a show confident enough to deepen rather than escalate - the stakes feel higher because the character has been earned, not because the plotting has been amplified. The Metacritic score of 88 reflects a rare second-season that matched rather than disappointed. The finale was widely cited as one of the best hours of British television in 2024.
seasons.season_over_season: Series 2 deepens where Series 1 provoked - the show trades novelty for accumulated emotional weight, and the result is somehow more devastating.
